description: KNaAl₂As₂O₉ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. K is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted KO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three AlO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent KO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-73°. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.67-3.09 Å. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.90 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one KO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, corners with five AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one KO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.10 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent KO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.96 Å. There are two inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four AlO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent KO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-53°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.77 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent KO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-57°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.75 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Al and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Al, and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one K and three Al atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Al, and one As atom.
